projects.title: Organization and Date Extraction from Policy Excerpts

bullets.text: Under project supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided policy records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under project supervision, used regular-expression and dictionary rules with Python re to extract organization and date spans, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.
Cleaned supplied policy metadata tables using provided steps and pandas; with guidance, plotted record counts using Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries.
Under research supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under research supervision, compared rule-based and pretrained spaCy extraction on held-out annotated research excerpts, checked span precision and recall, and analyzed errors by entity type.
Under research supervision, joined research document identifiers to bibliographic metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
Under research supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided company report records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under research supervision, compared rule-based and pretrained spaCy extraction on held-out annotated company report excerpts, checked span precision and recall, and analyzed errors by entity type.
Under research supervision, joined company report document identifiers to metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
